task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'If you move the ball, you must also take the key' maps to RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) hard, and 'Then pick up the box in the other room' commands the goal Existence(target_picked_up) hard. Together they express the task; has_door_key is a condition of the if-sentence, not a goal, so no Existence for it is needed.

texts: If blocker_moved happens, has_door_key must also happen.
